environmentVariables.description: Your Unreal project folder or its .uproject file. The server reads the capability token from <project>/Saved/MCP/capability-token.
environmentVariables.name: UE_PROJECT_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Capability token to present to the editor. Only needed when the server cannot read the project folder.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTOMATION_CAPABILITY_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: The editor's native MCP endpoint (Project Settings > EngineWire > Native MCP Port).
environmentVariables.name: UNREAL_MCP_URL

environmentVariables.description: Log level. Logs go to stderr.
environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL

server.name: io.github.Chidi09/variantrade
server.description: Read your VarianTrade portfolio, positions, risk and signals. Trades are proposal-only.

server.name: io.github.Chill-AI-Space/vault
server.description: MCP server for credential isolation — bots use passwords and API keys without seeing them
server.title: Vault MCP

server.name: io.github.ChiragBachani/context-autopilot
server.description: Mines your Claude Code and Cursor sessions into evidence-based CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md rules.

server.name: io.github.Chiru144/spotify-soundtrack-mcp
server.description: Spotify + TMDB tools: movie soundtrack playlists, playlist curation, taste stats and playback.
server.title: Spotify Soundtrack MCP

packageArguments.description: Run the MCP server over stdio.
packageArguments.name: --transport

environmentVariables.description: Client ID of your Spotify app (https://developer.spotify.com/dashboard). Sign-in uses PKCE, so no client secret is needed.
environmentVariables.name: SPOTIPY_CLIENT_ID

environmentVariables.description: Redirect URI registered for your Spotify app.
environmentVariables.name: SPOTIPY_REDIRECT_URI

environmentVariables.description: TMDB v3 API key for movie, cast and filmography lookups. Set this or TMDB_READ_ACCESS_TOKEN.
environmentVariables.name: TMDB_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: TMDB v4 Read Access Token, an alternative to TMDB_API_KEY.
environmentVariables.name: TMDB_READ_ACCESS_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated toolsets to load: core, playback, playlists, search, taste, library, browse or all.
environmentVariables.name: SPOTIFY_TOOLSETS

server.name: io.github.ChloePark85/kr-groundtruth
server.description: Korean fact-verification tools for AI agents: business registration, address, DART, apt prices, laws

server.name: io.github.ChloePark85/picright
server.description: License-aware images for markdown: CC/stock search, screenshots, Mermaid diagrams, provenance

environmentVariables.description: Optional Pixabay API key (Openverse works without any key)
environmentVariables.name: PIXABAY_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Optional Pexels API key (Openverse works without any key)
environmentVariables.name: PEXELS_API_KEY
